overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether object is a name-string vs. a Variable/Field reference); collapsed into one overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If specified, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

sentinelValues.meaning: Resize horizontal none -- neither width nor position changes when the window widens
Resize horizontal grow -- the object's width grows proportionally with the window's width
Resize horizontal move -- the object moves right by the same pixel amount the window grows
Resize vertical none -- neither height nor position changes when the window grows taller
Resize vertical grow -- the object's height grows proportionally with the window's height
Resize vertical move -- the object moves down by the same pixel amount the window grows

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Sets or dynamically modifies, for the current process, how the object(s) designated by object and * are resized/repositioned when the form window is resized.
